title: [RPG Design Guides] Are Recent Games Boring?

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】最近のゲームはつまらない？
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Are Recent Games Boring?

blocks.source: 「最近のゲームはつまらん。昔のゲームは面白かった」
blocks.translation: "Games these days are boring. Games from the past were fun."

blocks.source: これはネット上なりリアルなり、色んな場所で飽きるほど聞いた意見かもしれない。「これだからゆとりは」「懐古厨、老害乙」みたいに、世代で分かれて罵り合いになることもあるが、こうなると不毛という他ないというもの。
blocks.translation: This may be an opinion you have heard so often—in various places, both online and in real life—that you are sick of it. Sometimes people split into opposing generations and hurl insults at each other, saying things like, “That’s what you get with the pampered generation,” or “Nostalgia freaks and boomers, lol.” Once it gets to that point, it can only be called pointless.

blocks.source: しかし、これを不毛で終わらせるのはもったいない。つまらないと感じるからには、それ相応の理由があるはず。一度、自分なりの視点で検証してみたい。
blocks.translation: However, it would be a waste to dismiss this as pointless. If something feels boring, there must be a corresponding reason. I would like to examine it from my own perspective, just once.

blocks.source: ※ゲームと書いていますが、サイトの性質上ＲＰＧが中心となります。
blocks.translation: ※Although I refer to games, this site naturally focuses mainly on RPGs.

blocks.source: ※筆者は見ての通りのＳＦＣ世代ですが、最近のＲＰＧもそれなりに好きです。でも、たくさんプレイする時間がないのが悩みです。
blocks.translation: ※As you can see, I belong to the SFC generation, but I also like recent RPGs to a reasonable extent. However, I am troubled by not having enough time to play many of them.

blocks.source: というわけで、世間でよくいわれている意見と個人的な主観を織り交ぜながら、色々と原因となる候補を挙げてみた。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, I have listed various possible causes, blending commonly held opinions with my own personal views.

blocks.source: 以降に詳細を記述してみる。一番に書きたかったのは『複雑すぎる』なので、面倒だったらそこだけでも読んで頂ければ。
blocks.translation: I will describe each one in detail below. The first thing I wanted to write about was “They are too complicated,” so if this seems like too much trouble, I would appreciate it if you could read at least that section.

blocks.source: 思い出補正
blocks.translation: Nostalgia Bias

blocks.source: 筆頭はやはりこれ。「昔のゲームが面白かったのは思い出補正。今のゲームのほうが面白い」という意見。思い出や初見のインパクトに勝てるものはなしというのは、その通り。その通りだけど、こればかりはどうにもならない。
blocks.translation: This is undoubtedly the foremost reason. There is an opinion that says, “The reason games from the past were fun is nostalgia bias. Games today are more fun.” It is true that nothing can beat the impact of memories or experiencing something for the first time. That is true, but there is nothing we can do about this one.

blocks.source: せめて、古い世代としては新しいものの邪魔をしないようにはしたいところ。「最近のゲームはつまらん。昔のゲームは面白かった」と大した理屈もなく唱え続けた上で、新しい作品を全否定してしまうでのは、老害といわれても仕方ない。
blocks.translation: At the very least, as an older generation, we should try not to get in the way of new things. If we keep proclaiming, without much of an argument, “Games these days are boring. Games from the past were fun,” and then completely dismiss every new work, we can hardly complain when we are called out-of-touch old fogeys.

blocks.source: 『最近のゲーム』といっても色々とある。ＦＦとＤＱだけではもちろんない。批判は具体的かつ建設的にするように気を付けたい。そうならないためのこの記事でもある。
blocks.translation: "There are all kinds of “recent games.” They certainly are not limited to FF and DQ. I want to be careful to make my criticism specific and constructive. That is also the purpose of this article.

blocks.source: 思い出補正なのか？ 本当に面白かったのか？
blocks.translation: Is it nostalgia bias? Were they really that fun?

blocks.source: それを見極めるには今一度、昔のゲームを改めてプレイしてみるとよいかもしれない。色々と勉強になるのでオススメ。
blocks.translation: To determine that, it might be a good idea to play some old games again with fresh eyes. I recommend it, since there is a lot to learn.

blocks.source: 簡単すぎる
blocks.translation: Too Easy

blocks.source: 「最近のゲームは簡単過ぎて手応えがない」という意見。「昔のゲームはもっと難しかった」というのは錯覚もあれば、実際に難しかったものまで様々。
blocks.translation: "There is an opinion that says, “Recent games are too easy and offer no challenge.” The claim that “games from the past were harder” can stem from an illusion, but some really were difficult; there is considerable variation.

blocks.source: 昔のゲームが難しかった理由として、今よりプレイヤーが若く未熟だったということも忘れてはならない。ＲＰＧなら、防御や補助魔法を有効に使うことを知らず、猪突猛進なプレイをしていた人も多いはず。
blocks.translation: We must also remember that one reason games from the past seemed difficult was that players were younger and less experienced than they are now. In an RPG, many people probably played recklessly, charging ahead without knowing how to use defense or support magic effectively.

blocks.source: また、昔のゲームバランスは洗練されていなかったため、難易度には大きくバラつきがある。例えば、ＤＱ２やＦＦ１～３を始めファミコンのＲＰＧには今やっても非常に難しいものが多い。
blocks.translation: Also, the game balance of older titles was not very polished, so difficulty varied considerably. For example, many NES RPGs—including DQ II and FF I–III—are still extremely difficult even today.

blocks.source: しかし、同じファミコンでもＤＱ４ならそれほどでもない。人によってはＰＳ２のＤＱ８のほうが難しいと感じる程度だろう。
blocks.translation: However, even among NES games, DQ IV is not particularly difficult. Some people might even find the PS2 version of DQ VIII more challenging.

blocks.source: 全体的にはストーリー重視の流れの中で、簡単になったかな～という印象があるけど、明らかに難しかったといえるのは、ファミコン時代まで。ＳＦＣ以降、実際はそこまで難易度低下してないのでは、というのが僕の意見。
blocks.translation: Overall, I do have the impression that games have become easier as the industry has shifted toward story-focused experiences. However, the period that can clearly be called difficult ends with the NES era. My opinion is that, from the SFC onward, the difficulty level has not actually declined that much.

blocks.source: せっかくなので、新しいほうが難しいんじゃね？ な例を挙げてみる。
blocks.translation: Since I have the opportunity, let me give some examples of games that might actually be harder in their newer incarnations.

blocks.source: ＦＦ５（ＳＦＣ）→１３（ＰＳ３）
blocks.translation: FF5 (SFC) →13 (PS3)

blocks.source: サガ１（ＧＢ）→アンリミテッドサガ（ＰＳ２）
blocks.translation: SaGa 1 (GB) → Unlimited: SaGa (PS2)

blocks.source: ポケモン赤緑（ＧＢ）→ダイヤパール（ＮＤＳ）
blocks.translation: Pokémon Red and Green (GB) → Diamond and Pearl (NDS)

blocks.source: 真女神転生２（ＳＦＣ）→３（ＰＳ２）
blocks.translation: Shin Megami Tensei II (SFC) → III (PS2)

blocks.source: ブレスオブファイア１（ＳＦＣ）→５（ＰＳ２）
blocks.translation: Breath of Fire I (SFC) → V (PS2)

blocks.source: ※新しい例が、既に新しくないのはお許しください。
blocks.translation: ※Please forgive me for calling these examples “new” even though they are no longer new.

blocks.source: グラフィック偏重によるゲーム性軽視
blocks.translation: Neglecting Gameplay Due to an Overemphasis on Graphics

blocks.source: とてもよく聞く意見。個人的にはグラフィックがよいこと事態は悪くないと思うし、ゲーム性が軽視されているという感触もさほどない。
blocks.translation: This is an opinion I hear very often. Personally, I do not think good graphics themselves are a bad thing, nor do I particularly feel that gameplay is being neglected.

blocks.source: これが言われ始めたのは、ＦＦ８の時代だったと記憶している。しかし、ＦＦ８に関していえば、ゲームデザインはＦＦ２以来の挑戦的な作りであって、その是非はともかくとして「ゲーム性を軽視している」なんて、単純にいわれる作品とは思わない。
blocks.translation: I recall that people began saying this around the time of FF VIII. However, as far as FF VIII is concerned, its game design was an ambitious effort unlike anything since FF II. Regardless of whether that was good or bad, I do not think it is a work that can simply be described as “neglecting gameplay.”

blocks.source: そのＦＦ８にしても今は昔。とはいえ、それ以降の作品にしてもゲーム性軽視という印象はさほどない。むしろ、システム自体は凝ったものが多く、調整にも長く時間をかけているという印象。
blocks.translation: Even FF VIII is now part of the past. Even so, I do not particularly get the impression that the works released afterward neglected gameplay either. If anything, many of their systems are quite elaborate, and they seem to have spent a long time fine-tuning them.

blocks.source: もっとも、僕はゲーム性に関して「手抜きはしてない」と言いたかっただけであって、グラフィック重視による問題がないとまではいえない。
blocks.translation: That said, I only wanted to say that they “did not cut corners” when it came to gameplay; I cannot go so far as to say that prioritizing graphics causes no problems.

blocks.source: 開発費の高騰。
blocks.translation: Rising development costs.

blocks.source: 演出時間によるテンポの悪化。
blocks.translation: Poorer pacing due to the length of presentations.

blocks.source: なんかは大いに問題かと思う。その詳細は次へ。
blocks.translation: These seem like major problems to me. More details on those next.

blocks.source: 開発費の高騰
blocks.translation: Rising Development Costs

blocks.source: これで何が一番困るかというと発売される作品自体が減ってしまったこと。特に開発が大変な長編ＲＰＧは数が減って寂しい限り。数が少ないということは、単純に良作との出会いも減ってしまう。
blocks.translation: The biggest problem this causes is that fewer games are being released in the first place. The number of long-form RPGs, which are particularly difficult to develop, has fallen, and that is truly disappointing. When there are fewer games, you naturally have fewer chances to discover a great one.

blocks.source: この流れを変えるのは、もはや難しいかもしれない。個人的にはアマチュアが少人数で手軽に長編ＲＰＧを出す時代が来れば面白いかなと思っている。もっとも、年単位の制作期間が当たり前のものを『手軽』といっていいかは怪しいけれど……。
blocks.translation: It may already be difficult to change this trend. Personally, I think it would be interesting if we entered an age when amateurs could easily release long-form RPGs with small teams. Still, it is questionable whether something that normally takes years to make can really be called “easy,” though…

blocks.source: テンポの悪化
blocks.translation: Worsening Pacing

blocks.source: 「長いロード時間や演出時間などによるゲームテンポの悪化。これこそが、最近のゲームをつまらなくしている」という意見。これは個人的な実感からも、間違いなくその通り。
blocks.translation: "There is an opinion that says, “The poor pacing of games caused by long loading times, lengthy presentations, and so on is what makes recent games boring.” Based on my own experience, I can say without a doubt that this is true.

blocks.source: 制作者としては、見た目にばかりこだわってテンポを犠牲にすることがないようにしたい。というかテンポの良さだって立派に『見た目』の一つなので、見栄えにこだわる人なら、なおさらこだわって欲しい。
blocks.translation: As a creator, I want to avoid sacrificing pacing by focusing too much on appearances. In fact, good pacing is itself an important part of a game’s “appearance,” so anyone who cares about presentation should care about it all the more.

blocks.source: もっとも、昔のゲームについても『テンポが良い』とは言い切れない部分がある。なんせファミコンのゲームなんて、ウィンドウを描画するだけでもっさりだ。ちゃんと比較すると、ファミコン版のＤＱ３よりも、ＰＳ版のＤＱ４や７のほうがロード時間や戦闘テンポが速かったりする。
blocks.translation: That said, it is not always possible to say that older games had good pacing either. NES games were sluggish enough that even drawing a window could take a while. When you make a proper comparison, the PS versions of DQ IV and VII sometimes have faster loading times and battle pacing than the NES version of DQ III.

blocks.source: 新しい作品だって、テンポを改善している例もたくさんあるので、そこは評価されてもよいと思う。
blocks.translation: There are also many examples of newer works improving their pacing, so I think they deserve credit for that.

blocks.source: 長すぎるプレイ時間
blocks.translation: Playtimes That Are Too Long

blocks.source: 「長すぎるプレイ時間こそが、最近のゲームをつまらなくしている元凶」という意見。個人的にはとても同意したい。
blocks.translation: "There is an opinion that says, “Excessively long playtimes are the root cause of recent games becoming boring.” Personally, I strongly agree.

blocks.source: 例えば、ＳＦＣのＲＰＧには１０～３０分程度でダンジョンが攻略できて、次々と新しいイベントへ進めるようになっている作品が多い。プレイが濃密になるので、熱中して冷めることなく進める。ゲームクリアも１５～３０時間とお手頃だ。
blocks.translation: For example, many SFC RPGs let you clear a dungeon in roughly 10–30 minutes and then move on to a series of new events. Because the gameplay is so dense, you can stay immersed and keep progressing without losing interest. Completing the game in 15–30 hours is also quite manageable.

blocks.source: これが今は１ダンジョン２～５時間とか、かかるのが当たり前になっている。長くなったぶん、内容が盛り込まれているかといわれると、そこは作品次第だ。コピペダンジョンやお使いクエストで水増ししているだけの例も多い。
blocks.translation: Nowadays, it has become normal for a single dungeon to take 2–5 hours. Whether the added length comes with more content depends on the game. There are also many examples that merely pad things out with copy-and-paste dungeons and fetch quests.

blocks.source: ダンジョンだけでなく町も広くて、疲れるのなんの。ゲームクリアまで５０時間オーバーが当たり前。時には１００時間オーバー。まさに社会人殺しだ。
blocks.translation: Not only are the dungeons large, but the towns are huge too, which is exhausting. Taking over 50 hours to finish a game is considered normal. Sometimes it takes over 100 hours. It is truly murder for working adults.

blocks.source: ていうか、無駄なところを削ったら開発費も抑えられるだろうに、何でそうしないのかは大いに疑問。
blocks.translation: I mean, cutting out the unnecessary parts would also reduce development costs, so I really do wonder why they do not do that.

blocks.source: マンネリ
blocks.translation: Stagnation

blocks.source: 「メーカーは確実に売れる人気シリーズ作品ばかりを作っている。結果、マンネリになっている」みたいにいわれるアレ。続いて「既存の枠に捕らわれない斬新な作品を作る必要がある」みたいに続く。
blocks.translation: "This is the familiar complaint that goes something like: “Makers only create popular series that are guaranteed to sell. As a result, everything has become repetitive.” It is usually followed by something like: “They need to create innovative works that are not bound by existing conventions.”

blocks.source: 一理ないこともないけれど、現実の結果を見る限り、個人的には違和感もある。というのも、どうも実際に売れている（＝プレイヤーに求められている）作品は手堅い作りのシリーズ作品が多いように感じるからだ。
blocks.translation: That argument isn't entirely without merit, but judging by the actual results, I personally still find it somewhat questionable. The reason is that I get the impression that the titles actually selling well (= the ones players want) tend to be solidly made entries in established series.

blocks.source: 例えば、以下のシリーズなんかはマンネリ気味傾向もあるけれど、それでもなかなか安定している。
blocks.translation: For example, the following series may be showing signs of becoming repetitive, but they have nevertheless remained fairly stable.

blocks.source: ドラクエシリーズ
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest series

blocks.source: ポケモンシリーズ
blocks.translation: Pokémon series

blocks.source: ペルソナシリーズ
blocks.translation: Persona series

blocks.source: テイルズオブシリーズ
blocks.translation: Tales series

blocks.source: 英雄伝説（軌跡シリーズ）
blocks.translation: The Legend of Heroes (Trails series)

blocks.source: 奇をてらって挑戦的なことをしたり、作風のブレがある（＝マンネリでない）シリーズほど、衰退しているように思えて仕方ない。また、開発期間が空いてタイトルが長くリリースされてない作品も衰退する傾向にある。
blocks.translation: I can't help but feel that the more a series tries to be unconventional and adventurous, or the more inconsistent its style becomes (= the less repetitive it is), the more it declines. Series whose titles go a long time without being released due to extended development periods also tend to decline.

blocks.source: ＦＦシリーズ
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy series

blocks.source: サガシリーズ
blocks.translation: SaGa series

blocks.source: ブレスオブファイアシリーズ
blocks.translation: Breath of Fire series

blocks.source: ワイルドアームズシリーズ
blocks.translation: Wild Arms series

blocks.source: 単なる品質低下で没落しているだけのような気も……。
blocks.translation: Though perhaps they're simply declining because of a drop in quality...

blocks.source: 人気シリーズというのは、需要があるから人気シリーズなわけで、それを大切に作り続けること事態はユーザの期待に応える意味でも悪くない。（さすがに乱発までは肯定しない。）また、シリーズたるものゲームデザインを急激に変化させると、ユーザも戸惑うというもの。よって手堅い作りで何が悪いのかなと。
blocks.translation: A popular series is popular because there is demand for it, so continuing to make it with care is not a bad thing, especially in terms of meeting users' expectations. (I certainly don't endorse churning out releases.) Also, when a series changes its game design too abruptly, users are bound to become confused. So what's wrong with making games in a solid, dependable way?

blocks.source: シリーズものをユーザの期待に応えるようにしっかり作る。→売上を出す。
blocks.translation: Make series titles properly, in a way that meets users' expectations. → Generate sales.

blocks.source: 売れた余力で、新規タイトルにも挑戦する。
blocks.translation: Use the profits from successful releases to take on new titles as well.

blocks.source: 結果を出した新規タイトルもシリーズ化する。
blocks.translation: Turn new titles that achieve good results into series too.

blocks.source: って感じでいいと思うのだけど、どうだろう？
blocks.translation: I think something along those lines would work well, but what do you think?

blocks.source: いえ、大して面白みのない意見であることは百も承知。ただ、売上という数値を見れば世間は思っているほど『斬新さ』を重視していないのではないかと。
blocks.translation: No, I fully realize this isn't a particularly interesting opinion. Still, looking at sales figures, perhaps the public doesn't value “innovation” as much as we think it does.

blocks.source: 複雑すぎる
blocks.translation: Too Complex

blocks.source: 個人的に一番力説したかったのがこれ。まず「最近のゲームは複雑すぎて、取っ付きにくいのではないか」というのが一つだが、そこに今回は重点を置かない。
blocks.translation: This is what I personally wanted to argue most strongly. One point is that “modern games may be too complex and difficult to get into,” but that is not what I want to focus on this time.

blocks.source: 力説したいのは、多くの要素を盛り込んで内容が複雑になった結果
blocks.translation: What I want to emphasize is that, as a result of packing in so many elements and making the content complex,

blocks.source: 「開発者自身が『シンプルな面白さ』を見失ったのではないか」
blocks.translation: "the developers themselves may have lost sight of ‘simple fun’"

blocks.source: ということ。シンプルな面白さって何ぞやという点については、これから例を挙げて説明してみる。
blocks.translation: That is what I mean. As for what exactly “simple fun” is, I will try to explain it with some examples.

blocks.source: 「ドラクエは『はがねのつるぎ』を買う頃が一番面白い」
blocks.translation: "Dragon Quest is most fun around the time you buy the Steel Sword"

blocks.source: ……という説をご存知だろうか？ これはドラクエの面白さを語る時によく出る話だ。なぜ、そう感じるのかということを突き詰めてみたい。
blocks.translation: Have you heard that theory...? This is something that often comes up when discussing what makes Dragon Quest fun. I want to explore why people feel that way.

blocks.source: とあるプレイヤーのＤＱ３
blocks.translation: A Certain Player's DQ III

blocks.source: 新しい町に着いたぞ。早速、店に行こう。
blocks.translation: I've reached a new town. Let's go to the shop right away.

blocks.source: 武器にしようか、防具にしようか？
blocks.translation: Should I buy a weapon or armor?

blocks.source: １０００Ｇしかないけど、はがねのつるぎ（１５００Ｇ）が欲しいなあ。
blocks.translation: I only have 1,000 G, but I want the Steel Sword (1,500 G).

blocks.source: 魔物を倒してお金を稼ぐぞ。
blocks.translation: I'll defeat monsters and earn some money.

blocks.source: やった！ ついに念願のはがねのつるぎを手に入れたぞ！
blocks.translation: Yes! I finally got the Steel Sword I've been wanting!

blocks.source: 攻撃力が一気に９アップ！
blocks.translation: Attack power increased by 9 all at once!

blocks.source: お下がりの『くさりがま』を僧侶に持たせて、さらにパーティ強化！
blocks.translation: Give the Priest the hand-me-down Chain Sickle and strengthen the party even further!

blocks.source: キラービーが一撃だ！ これで塔も攻略できる！
blocks.translation: The Killer Bee goes down in one hit! Now I can conquer the tower!

blocks.source: 何の変哲もないプレイの一形態である。しかし、この中にプレイヤーが面白いと感じる点がいくつも凝縮されていることが分かるだろうか？
blocks.translation: This is an utterly ordinary way to play. But can you see how many things players find enjoyable are packed into it?

blocks.source: 新しい町に到着して、店を覗くワクワク感。
blocks.translation: The excitement of arriving in a new town and peeking into its shops.

blocks.source: 武器か防具か。何を買うかを悩む楽しさ。
blocks.translation: The fun of wondering whether to buy a weapon or armor, and deciding what to purchase.

blocks.source: 目標を立ててお金を稼ぐことによる達成感。
blocks.translation: The sense of accomplishment that comes from setting a goal and earning money.

blocks.source: 戦闘が楽になって、キャラクターが強くなったという実感。
blocks.translation: The feeling that your character has grown stronger as battles become easier.

blocks.source: 次なるダンジョン攻略に駆り立てる挑戦心。
blocks.translation: The desire to take on the next dungeon.

blocks.source: 実にシンプル。各要素が明快に面白さに繋がっている。
blocks.translation: It's remarkably simple. Each element clearly contributes to the fun.

blocks.source: 振り返ってみて、最近のゲームはどうだろうか？ こういったシンプルな面白さを超えているだろうか？ 以下のようになっていないだろうか？
blocks.translation: Looking back, what about modern games? Do they go beyond this kind of simple fun? Could they instead be turning out like this?

blocks.source: 強い武器は宝箱から簡単に手に入る。達成感がない。
blocks.translation: Powerful weapons are easily obtained from treasure chests. There is no sense of accomplishment.

blocks.source: 店の装備は簡単に買える。買い物は装備を全て更新するだけの作業。
blocks.translation: Shop equipment is easy to buy. Shopping is merely a matter of replacing all your equipment.

blocks.source: 達成感もなければ悩む楽しさもない。新しい店があってもワクワクしない。
blocks.translation: There is neither a sense of accomplishment nor the pleasure of deliberation. Even finding a new shop doesn't feel exciting.

blocks.source: 宝箱、戦利品、店……というように少し進むと次の装備がすぐ手に入る。
blocks.translation: Whether from treasure chests, as loot, or from shops... the next piece of equipment is obtained almost immediately after making even a little progress.

blocks.source: 結果的に装備を変えても一個あたりの変化は小さく、キャラクターが強くなった実感に乏しい。
blocks.translation: As a result, even when you change equipment, each individual upgrade makes little difference, so you barely feel that your character has grown stronger.

blocks.source: 敵も大して強くないので苦戦しない。
blocks.translation: The enemies aren't particularly strong either, so you never struggle.

blocks.source: だからやっぱり、キャラクターが強くなった実感に乏しい。
blocks.translation: So once again, you barely feel that your character has grown stronger.

blocks.source: 次のダンジョンもどうせ余裕なので、何も考えず突っ込むだけ。
blocks.translation: Since the next dungeon will be easy anyway, I just charge in without thinking.

blocks.source: 最近はこんなゲームが珍しくないようにも思う。アイテムが大量にあって、宝箱からも魔物からも店からも次々と入手できる。一見、嬉しいのだが結果として、ひとつひとつの事象が軽くなってはいないだろうか？
blocks.translation: Lately, I feel like games like this are no longer uncommon. They have huge numbers of items, which you can acquire one after another from treasure chests, monsters, and shops. At first glance, that seems nice, but as a result, doesn't it make each individual event feel less meaningful?

blocks.source: とても色んな要素が盛り込まれているはずなのに、気づいてみればファミコンのゲームよりも悩む楽しさがない。プレイは単調。しかも、面白さに貢献していない数々の無駄要素によって、複雑さと面倒臭さだけは格段にアップ。そんな風にはならないように自戒したい。
blocks.translation: Even though these games are supposedly packed with all kinds of elements, before you know it, they offer less of the fun of thinking things through than Famicom games. The gameplay is monotonous. On top of that, all the unnecessary elements that don't contribute to the fun greatly increase only the complexity and tedium. I want to keep myself from making my game turn out that way.

texts.「最近のゲームはつまらん。昔のゲームは面白かった」: "Games these days are boring. Games from the past were fun."
texts.これはネット上なりリアルなり、色んな場所で飽きるほど聞いた意見かもしれない。「こ: This may be an opinion you have heard so often—in various places, both online and in real life—that you are sick of it. Sometimes people split into opposing generations and hurl insults at each other, saying things like, “That’s what you get with the pampered generation,” or “Nostalgia freaks and boomers, lol.” Once it gets to that point, it can only be called pointless.
texts.しかし、これを不毛で終わらせるのはもったいない。つまらないと感じるからには、それ: However, it would be a waste to dismiss this as pointless. If something feels boring, there must be a corresponding reason. I would like to examine it from my own perspective, just once.
texts.※ゲームと書いていますが、サイトの性質上ＲＰＧが中心となります。: ※Although I refer to games, this site naturally focuses mainly on RPGs.
texts.※筆者は見ての通りのＳＦＣ世代ですが、最近のＲＰＧもそれなりに好きです。でも、た: ※As you can see, I belong to the SFC generation, but I also like recent RPGs to a reasonable extent. However, I am troubled by not having enough time to play many of them.
texts.というわけで、世間でよくいわれている意見と個人的な主観を織り交ぜながら、色々と原: With that in mind, I have listed various possible causes, blending commonly held opinions with my own personal views.
texts.以降に詳細を記述してみる。一番に書きたかったのは『複雑すぎる』なので、面倒だった: I will describe each one in detail below. The first thing I wanted to write about was “They are too complicated,” so if this seems like too much trouble, I would appreciate it if you could read at least that section.
texts.筆頭はやはりこれ。「昔のゲームが面白かったのは思い出補正。今のゲームのほうが面白: This is undoubtedly the foremost reason. There is an opinion that says, “The reason games from the past were fun is nostalgia bias. Games today are more fun.” It is true that nothing can beat the impact of memories or experiencing something for the first time. That is true, but there is nothing we can do about this one.
texts.せめて、古い世代としては新しいものの邪魔をしないようにはしたいところ。「最近のゲ: At the very least, as an older generation, we should try not to get in the way of new things. If we keep proclaiming, without much of an argument, “Games these days are boring. Games from the past were fun,” and then completely dismiss every new work, we can hardly complain when we are called out-of-touch old fogeys.
texts.『最近のゲーム』といっても色々とある。ＦＦとＤＱだけではもちろんない。批判は具体: "There are all kinds of “recent games.” They certainly are not limited to FF and DQ. I want to be careful to make my criticism specific and constructive. That is also the purpose of this article.
texts.思い出補正なのか？ 本当に面白かったのか？: Is it nostalgia bias? Were they really that fun?
texts.それを見極めるには今一度、昔のゲームを改めてプレイしてみるとよいかもしれない。色: To determine that, it might be a good idea to play some old games again with fresh eyes. I recommend it, since there is a lot to learn.
texts.「最近のゲームは簡単過ぎて手応えがない」という意見。「昔のゲームはもっと難しかっ: "There is an opinion that says, “Recent games are too easy and offer no challenge.” The claim that “games from the past were harder” can stem from an illusion, but some really were difficult; there is considerable variation.
texts.昔のゲームが難しかった理由として、今よりプレイヤーが若く未熟だったということも忘: We must also remember that one reason games from the past seemed difficult was that players were younger and less experienced than they are now. In an RPG, many people probably played recklessly, charging ahead without knowing how to use defense or support magic effectively.
texts.また、昔のゲームバランスは洗練されていなかったため、難易度には大きくバラつきがあ: Also, the game balance of older titles was not very polished, so difficulty varied considerably. For example, many NES RPGs—including DQ II and FF I–III—are still extremely difficult even today.
texts.しかし、同じファミコンでもＤＱ４ならそれほどでもない。人によってはＰＳ２のＤＱ８: However, even among NES games, DQ IV is not particularly difficult. Some people might even find the PS2 version of DQ VIII more challenging.
texts.全体的にはストーリー重視の流れの中で、簡単になったかな～という印象があるけど、明: Overall, I do have the impression that games have become easier as the industry has shifted toward story-focused experiences. However, the period that can clearly be called difficult ends with the NES era. My opinion is that, from the SFC onward, the difficulty level has not actually declined that much.
texts.せっかくなので、新しいほうが難しいんじゃね？ な例を挙げてみる。: Since I have the opportunity, let me give some examples of games that might actually be harder in their newer incarnations.
texts.ポケモン赤緑（ＧＢ）→ダイヤパール（ＮＤＳ）: Pokémon Red and Green (GB) → Diamond and Pearl (NDS)
texts.※新しい例が、既に新しくないのはお許しください。: ※Please forgive me for calling these examples “new” even though they are no longer new.
texts.グラフィック偏重によるゲーム性軽視: Neglecting Gameplay Due to an Overemphasis on Graphics
texts.とてもよく聞く意見。個人的にはグラフィックがよいこと事態は悪くないと思うし、ゲー: This is an opinion I hear very often. Personally, I do not think good graphics themselves are a bad thing, nor do I particularly feel that gameplay is being neglected.
texts.これが言われ始めたのは、ＦＦ８の時代だったと記憶している。しかし、ＦＦ８に関して: I recall that people began saying this around the time of FF VIII. However, as far as FF VIII is concerned, its game design was an ambitious effort unlike anything since FF II. Regardless of whether that was good or bad, I do not think it is a work that can simply be described as “neglecting gameplay.”
texts.そのＦＦ８にしても今は昔。とはいえ、それ以降の作品にしてもゲーム性軽視という印象: Even FF VIII is now part of the past. Even so, I do not particularly get the impression that the works released afterward neglected gameplay either. If anything, many of their systems are quite elaborate, and they seem to have spent a long time fine-tuning them.
texts.もっとも、僕はゲーム性に関して「手抜きはしてない」と言いたかっただけであって、グ: That said, I only wanted to say that they “did not cut corners” when it came to gameplay; I cannot go so far as to say that prioritizing graphics causes no problems.
texts.演出時間によるテンポの悪化。: Poorer pacing due to the length of presentations.
texts.なんかは大いに問題かと思う。その詳細は次へ。: These seem like major problems to me. More details on those next.
texts.これで何が一番困るかというと発売される作品自体が減ってしまったこと。特に開発が大: The biggest problem this causes is that fewer games are being released in the first place. The number of long-form RPGs, which are particularly difficult to develop, has fallen, and that is truly disappointing. When there are fewer games, you naturally have fewer chances to discover a great one.
texts.この流れを変えるのは、もはや難しいかもしれない。個人的にはアマチュアが少人数で手: It may already be difficult to change this trend. Personally, I think it would be interesting if we entered an age when amateurs could easily release long-form RPGs with small teams. Still, it is questionable whether something that normally takes years to make can really be called “easy,” though…
texts.「長いロード時間や演出時間などによるゲームテンポの悪化。これこそが、最近のゲーム: "There is an opinion that says, “The poor pacing of games caused by long loading times, lengthy presentations, and so on is what makes recent games boring.” Based on my own experience, I can say without a doubt that this is true.
texts.制作者としては、見た目にばかりこだわってテンポを犠牲にすることがないようにしたい: As a creator, I want to avoid sacrificing pacing by focusing too much on appearances. In fact, good pacing is itself an important part of a game’s “appearance,” so anyone who cares about presentation should care about it all the more.
texts.もっとも、昔のゲームについても『テンポが良い』とは言い切れない部分がある。なんせ: That said, it is not always possible to say that older games had good pacing either. NES games were sluggish enough that even drawing a window could take a while. When you make a proper comparison, the PS versions of DQ IV and VII sometimes have faster loading times and battle pacing than the NES version of DQ III.
texts.新しい作品だって、テンポを改善している例もたくさんあるので、そこは評価されてもよ: There are also many examples of newer works improving their pacing, so I think they deserve credit for that.
texts.「長すぎるプレイ時間こそが、最近のゲームをつまらなくしている元凶」という意見。個: "There is an opinion that says, “Excessively long playtimes are the root cause of recent games becoming boring.” Personally, I strongly agree.
texts.例えば、ＳＦＣのＲＰＧには１０～３０分程度でダンジョンが攻略できて、次々と新しい: For example, many SFC RPGs let you clear a dungeon in roughly 10–30 minutes and then move on to a series of new events. Because the gameplay is so dense, you can stay immersed and keep progressing without losing interest. Completing the game in 15–30 hours is also quite manageable.
texts.これが今は１ダンジョン２～５時間とか、かかるのが当たり前になっている。長くなった: Nowadays, it has become normal for a single dungeon to take 2–5 hours. Whether the added length comes with more content depends on the game. There are also many examples that merely pad things out with copy-and-paste dungeons and fetch quests.
texts.ダンジョンだけでなく町も広くて、疲れるのなんの。ゲームクリアまで５０時間オーバー: Not only are the dungeons large, but the towns are huge too, which is exhausting. Taking over 50 hours to finish a game is considered normal. Sometimes it takes over 100 hours. It is truly murder for working adults.
texts.ていうか、無駄なところを削ったら開発費も抑えられるだろうに、何でそうしないのかは: I mean, cutting out the unnecessary parts would also reduce development costs, so I really do wonder why they do not do that.
texts.「メーカーは確実に売れる人気シリーズ作品ばかりを作っている。結果、マンネリになっ: "This is the familiar complaint that goes something like: “Makers only create popular series that are guaranteed to sell. As a result, everything has become repetitive.” It is usually followed by something like: “They need to create innovative works that are not bound by existing conventions.”
texts.一理ないこともないけれど、現実の結果を見る限り、個人的には違和感もある。というの: That argument isn't entirely without merit, but judging by the actual results, I personally still find it somewhat questionable. The reason is that I get the impression that the titles actually selling well (= the ones players want) tend to be solidly made entries in established series.
texts.例えば、以下のシリーズなんかはマンネリ気味傾向もあるけれど、それでもなかなか安定: For example, the following series may be showing signs of becoming repetitive, but they have nevertheless remained fairly stable.
texts.奇をてらって挑戦的なことをしたり、作風のブレがある（＝マンネリでない）シリーズほ: I can't help but feel that the more a series tries to be unconventional and adventurous, or the more inconsistent its style becomes (= the less repetitive it is), the more it declines. Series whose titles go a long time without being released due to extended development periods also tend to decline.
texts.単なる品質低下で没落しているだけのような気も……。: Though perhaps they're simply declining because of a drop in quality...
texts.人気シリーズというのは、需要があるから人気シリーズなわけで、それを大切に作り続け: A popular series is popular because there is demand for it, so continuing to make it with care is not a bad thing, especially in terms of meeting users' expectations. (I certainly don't endorse churning out releases.) Also, when a series changes its game design too abruptly, users are bound to become confused. So what's wrong with making games in a solid, dependable way?
texts.シリーズものをユーザの期待に応えるようにしっかり作る。→売上を出す。: Make series titles properly, in a way that meets users' expectations. → Generate sales.
texts.売れた余力で、新規タイトルにも挑戦する。: Use the profits from successful releases to take on new titles as well.
texts.結果を出した新規タイトルもシリーズ化する。: Turn new titles that achieve good results into series too.
texts.って感じでいいと思うのだけど、どうだろう？: I think something along those lines would work well, but what do you think?
texts.いえ、大して面白みのない意見であることは百も承知。ただ、売上という数値を見れば世: No, I fully realize this isn't a particularly interesting opinion. Still, looking at sales figures, perhaps the public doesn't value “innovation” as much as we think it does.
texts.個人的に一番力説したかったのがこれ。まず「最近のゲームは複雑すぎて、取っ付きにく: This is what I personally wanted to argue most strongly. One point is that “modern games may be too complex and difficult to get into,” but that is not what I want to focus on this time.
texts.力説したいのは、多くの要素を盛り込んで内容が複雑になった結果: What I want to emphasize is that, as a result of packing in so many elements and making the content complex,
texts.「開発者自身が『シンプルな面白さ』を見失ったのではないか」: "the developers themselves may have lost sight of ‘simple fun’"
texts.ということ。シンプルな面白さって何ぞやという点については、これから例を挙げて説明: That is what I mean. As for what exactly “simple fun” is, I will try to explain it with some examples.
texts.「ドラクエは『はがねのつるぎ』を買う頃が一番面白い」: "Dragon Quest is most fun around the time you buy the Steel Sword"
texts.……という説をご存知だろうか？ これはドラクエの面白さを語る時によく出る話だ。な: Have you heard that theory...? This is something that often comes up when discussing what makes Dragon Quest fun. I want to explore why people feel that way.
texts.新しい町に着いたぞ。早速、店に行こう。: I've reached a new town. Let's go to the shop right away.
texts.武器にしようか、防具にしようか？: Should I buy a weapon or armor?
texts.１０００Ｇしかないけど、はがねのつるぎ（１５００Ｇ）が欲しいなあ。: I only have 1,000 G, but I want the Steel Sword (1,500 G).
texts.魔物を倒してお金を稼ぐぞ。: I'll defeat monsters and earn some money.
texts.やった！ ついに念願のはがねのつるぎを手に入れたぞ！: Yes! I finally got the Steel Sword I've been wanting!
texts.攻撃力が一気に９アップ！: Attack power increased by 9 all at once!
texts.お下がりの『くさりがま』を僧侶に持たせて、さらにパーティ強化！: Give the Priest the hand-me-down Chain Sickle and strengthen the party even further!
texts.キラービーが一撃だ！ これで塔も攻略できる！: The Killer Bee goes down in one hit! Now I can conquer the tower!
texts.何の変哲もないプレイの一形態である。しかし、この中にプレイヤーが面白いと感じる点: This is an utterly ordinary way to play. But can you see how many things players find enjoyable are packed into it?
texts.新しい町に到着して、店を覗くワクワク感。: The excitement of arriving in a new town and peeking into its shops.
texts.武器か防具か。何を買うかを悩む楽しさ。: The fun of wondering whether to buy a weapon or armor, and deciding what to purchase.
texts.目標を立ててお金を稼ぐことによる達成感。: The sense of accomplishment that comes from setting a goal and earning money.
texts.戦闘が楽になって、キャラクターが強くなったという実感。: The feeling that your character has grown stronger as battles become easier.
texts.次なるダンジョン攻略に駆り立てる挑戦心。: The desire to take on the next dungeon.
texts.実にシンプル。各要素が明快に面白さに繋がっている。: It's remarkably simple. Each element clearly contributes to the fun.
texts.振り返ってみて、最近のゲームはどうだろうか？ こういったシンプルな面白さを超えて: Looking back, what about modern games? Do they go beyond this kind of simple fun? Could they instead be turning out like this?
texts.強い武器は宝箱から簡単に手に入る。達成感がない。: Powerful weapons are easily obtained from treasure chests. There is no sense of accomplishment.
texts.店の装備は簡単に買える。買い物は装備を全て更新するだけの作業。: Shop equipment is easy to buy. Shopping is merely a matter of replacing all your equipment.
texts.達成感もなければ悩む楽しさもない。新しい店があってもワクワクしない。: There is neither a sense of accomplishment nor the pleasure of deliberation. Even finding a new shop doesn't feel exciting.
texts.宝箱、戦利品、店……というように少し進むと次の装備がすぐ手に入る。: Whether from treasure chests, as loot, or from shops... the next piece of equipment is obtained almost immediately after making even a little progress.
texts.結果的に装備を変えても一個あたりの変化は小さく、キャラクターが強くなった実感に乏: As a result, even when you change equipment, each individual upgrade makes little difference, so you barely feel that your character has grown stronger.
texts.敵も大して強くないので苦戦しない。: The enemies aren't particularly strong either, so you never struggle.
texts.だからやっぱり、キャラクターが強くなった実感に乏しい。: So once again, you barely feel that your character has grown stronger.
texts.次のダンジョンもどうせ余裕なので、何も考えず突っ込むだけ。: Since the next dungeon will be easy anyway, I just charge in without thinking.
texts.最近はこんなゲームが珍しくないようにも思う。アイテムが大量にあって、宝箱からも魔: Lately, I feel like games like this are no longer uncommon. They have huge numbers of items, which you can acquire one after another from treasure chests, monsters, and shops. At first glance, that seems nice, but as a result, doesn't it make each individual event feel less meaningful?
texts.とても色んな要素が盛り込まれているはずなのに、気づいてみればファミコンのゲームよ: Even though these games are supposedly packed with all kinds of elements, before you know it, they offer less of the fun of thinking things through than Famicom games. The gameplay is monotonous. On top of that, all the unnecessary elements that don't contribute to the fun greatly increase only the complexity and tedium. I want to keep myself from making my game turn out that way.
